title: DECISION: Dynamic timeout proportional to blob size with fixed bounds
description: fetch_peer_blob (line 373) uses timeout = (expected_size / 65536).saturating_add(30).min(300) seconds. Rejects static timeout in favor of dynamic scaling: baseline 30s + ~1.5s per 100MB, capped at 5min. Prevents stalled downloads from hanging forever while allowing large blobs to complete. Saturating_add prevents arithmetic panic on huge sizes.
